problems: The Cliopatria rows are longer than the states: 'First Hellenic Republic' is the whole Greek state 1822-1940 (resumes as the 'Kingdom of Greece' row 1945-1966, slug kingdom-of-greece); the 1940 dissolve event is a technical close at confidence 1.

united-principalities-of-moldavia-and-wallachia is the Old Kingdom of Romania; the dossier is extended over 1917-1918 with two new keyframes and ends December 1918, where the 'Kingdom of Romania' row (1919-1947, slug kingdom-of-romania, shares Q203493 with 'Romania') begins. The kingdom-of-romania dossier may start in 1881 and overlap: reconcile.
montenegro keeps one Cliopatria row with two lives (1853-1915 and 2006-2024) as one dossier with a merge in 1918 and a gain in 2006; a gap-filler may prefer two.
The cretan-state dossier (eu-18, other part) ends in October 1908 with Crete passing to first-hellenic-republic, but the Treaty of Bucharest page says Crete was taken over on 14 December 1913.

The ottoman-empire dossier (me-10) dates the Greek gain of the Peloponnese and central Greece to 1829 and the contest end to 1830; this batch has 1828 and September 1829 from the Greek War of Independence page.

Occupation events for 1916-1918 (Montenegro, Romania) are written from the occupied state's side with the occupier as counterpart, like the serbs dossier; the schema's wording could be read the other way.

Sources: 19 per-dossier entries, 16 distinct pages (Treaty of Berlin 1878 and Treaty of Bucharest 1913 reused). One page (Romanian_campaign_(World_War_I)) failed with the wrong capitalisation and loaded as Romanian_Campaign_(World_War_I). The Montenegro validator warning is the unknown predecessor slug prince-bishopric-of-montenegro.
